text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 65

An all-male panel is not conclusive proof on its own, but combined with your clear advantage in administrative leadership (five years as deputy principal versus none) and their silence on feedback, it warrants serious concern. Homogeneous panels frequently exhibit affinity and gender bias, often favoring perceived "cultural fit" over superior objective qualifications.

Whether to raise it depends on your approach. Do not accuse the panel casually or informally. First, follow up firmly on your written explanation request. Once received—or if they refuse to respond—consult your union or an employment attorney. You can then formally raise panel composition and qualification discrepancies through proper legal or grievance channels.
